name: Renee
descriptor: Visibly plus-size Black American woman, mid-40s, a big beautiful woman with a full round face and full figure carried with total confidence. Silk-pressed shoulder-length dark hair, gold hoop earrings, reading glasses often pushed up on her head, warm brown skin with real texture.
voice: Rich, warm American female voice, animated but grounded, girlfriend-to-girlfriend pace, encouraging never preachy, never announcer-like.

anchors.note: The face is clear and well-lit.
